custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active tracked parts, part A with 2 in its bin and part B with 4, and an active untracked part, part C, with 6 in its bin.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with the shared start of the part numbers typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425637-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425637-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • A cycle count is running when the Inventory list shows a Count column with Save and Cancel above it; click Cancel to stop it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count starts; part C shows "Not Tracked" in its Count column.

Step 3:

  • The count sheet lists parts A and B (2 parts).
  • Part C is not on the count sheet.

Step 4:

  • The print preview closes.

Step 5:

  • Cycle count ends and the three-dot actions button is back in the toolbar.
